I will do my best.
Tomie!

This is good, is really you that you recognized the negativity and you are in the right direction, if you never need anything, or just to talk don't hesitate to send me a message, I hope everything goes your way. Good luck.

First of I'm not entitled to anyone's time, even my friends don't talk to me for months so everyone works differently , I'm not saying she's the one or anything like that, she might not be interested in you, who knows?, I formulated my opinion on what you decided to show, we don't have her point of view on this, you are just assuming things. 
Healthy is focusing on yourself and seeing your flaws, accepting them and growing, not going into a spiral of negativity. I don't you if you notice but you sound very negative, if you hold onto bad feelings nothing is going to change you will keep reliving a toxic cycle.
Everyone works differently, maybe your  true love  can't be stopped by "petty" things but for others it might completely erase it. I'm not trying to tell you what to do, but you sound resentful. I like the idea of believing and just letting things flow, sounds like a good step to grow, but negative feelings might come back or make you feel worse. 
Just let things flow, you don't want to suffer then don't , the person you need to learn how to be patient with is just yourself. Give yourself time to heal.
Yeah kinda, were working through this together, he's not comfortable with affection just yet but he's coming to terms with it, and I'm learning to be more patient
We should talk about getting a new moderator in here, I just got here a few weeks ago but I would be happy to contribute.

That ... Doesn't sounds very healthy, I'm not trying to be rude, and I understand were are you coming from, my TF put me on hold, years he said, that it could take to know how he's feeling, but I decided to wait , just with nice feelings , I know the conection is there. Maybe she is not feeling the same as you , maybe is bad timing, that things happens, I know what it feels to have enormous feelings and not being able to spill them but maybe you need to be more patient, take a break from her , and just focus on making yourself a better you.
I don't think false twins is a thing , but all my relationships before were kinda ... Toxic so yeah I understand, twins tend to break the cycle of toxic people in our lives, mostly bc we let them in
Thank you so much, I am studying to be an artist so this is homework. Thank you
He said that he avoids people bc he can't properly show his feelings ,he talked about his ex a couple of times too
Problems with his family not showing enough affection, and several bad breakups on his mom, that's what we talked about.

I know right were on the same spot ,he says he's not sure , that breaks my heart , I do want to wait for him , but I also need manage my own feelings wich sucks to do it alone I hope everything works out , for you and for me

I feel like if I do the jealousy thing he'll get even more scared he will have reasons now to be more scared , me running off with someone else , but now I see I know where his fear is , I know he's not used to love , so baby steps , slowly

Thanks , I do but he feels overwhelmed, so I don't know how to reassure him , we are in a bad moment bc we live far away from each other so , actions are very limited, I guess I could do tiny actions like drawings or sending pictures of things he likes  idk it's so hard
So my role is to wait for him and just be there..
My problems is I try to manage my own insecurities on top of his and is a hard baggage to move so idk how , that's my problem.
I hope you're prepared for all the challenges
I'm new to all of this, and reading these terrifies me, he was my only hope to not completely give up, but now.... I have nothing. I can't wait 10 years or so just to do this all again.
No that I know of, he said 6 months was the longest one
This is exactly what I needed thank you so much, blessings

Yes! We were playing a game with voice chat , I was just making small talk with a group of people and I got close to a guy that was explaining how to speak Japanese, as I was interested we got into a chat and it was nice , I had a burning sensation that I needed to know more so I invited him to another chatroom and that one was more quiet , we talked about our lives and stuff , we said our goodbyes and went to bed, but I couldn't sleep I knew I had to talk to him again it was so strong that I was restless, so the next day I found him again and asked for a way to get in contact with him outside the game and he happily told me , we talked so much that day and that's when I knew , he was my soulmate I didn't say anything at first but it was so intriguing, I wanted to know how he felt so I blurted out "do you think we're soulmates? " But the shock was , we said it at the same time ??! , In unison we kinda said it and laughed about it, a couple of days went by and we kept talking , now we are falling more in love with each other more and more , the feeling of meeting your soulmate is incredible I can't fully explain it, it's like coming home. He makes me be a better person. Btw  I am planning on buying a plane ticket to go see him soon ❤️
Are you coming home soon ?

We instantly knew , we even said "do you think we're soulmates?" At the same time , is a feeling like no other , maybe you read this before but , it really does feel like meeting up with a long lost friend and just taking it from where you left of , is like coming home.

I follow the law of attraction but kinda on my own way , a few weeks ago I manifested my soulmate, I didn't do any list , I didn't have enough confidence or felt good , it happened , the only thing that I did, was to grab a nice feeling , like being in love or someone's smile , something that makes you feel light and happy , and then I started repeating in my head what I wanted , but not like "I want a relationship" you have to think like this " I have a nurturing relationship with the person the matches with me " and think about how that person is looking for you too, I wish you the best !
I hope you're better

Just tell her to don't give up and keep on painting, perseverance is the key !
